messages:
tina_support: Heads-up — GoodHelp (nonprofit) hit a hard block paying invoice INV-2026-349. Card shows as declined but our billing logs indicate tax/VAT validation failed first (422). They asked if we can move payment terms to match their grant cycle (requested much longer than our standard). Need finance and eng input for provisional terms + repro.
sam_billing: Got it. can you paste the invoice id (copied) and the tax id the customer provided? any gateway decline codes from the PSP?

tina_support: Invoice: INV-2026-349. Tax ID they supplied: GB999999973. Payment method: AMEX on file. PSP logs show a generic `card_decline` but our service log shows we never hit PSP because the billing API returned 422 tax validation error.

alexa_eng: I can reproduce locally. When I POST to /payments with that VAT the validation service rejects it. Example repro (sanitized):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/payments \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-349","amount":12500,"tax_id":"GB999999973"}'
```
Response:

```json
{ "status": 422, "error": "invalid_tax_id", "details": "vat format not recognized" }
```

sam_billing: huh. that `invalid_tax_id` path should only hit if VAT is malformed. their id looks plausible. any recent changes to normalization/validation?

alexa_eng: Yes — found a regression in the VAT normalization regex. For some UK VAT numbers we stripped leading characters during normalization which then triggered the downstream validator. i've got a small fix in review (PR #4321). Workaround in the meantime: add a metadata key `raw_tax_id` on the invoice (billing console or API) and the validator will skip normalization.

lee_finance: From finance side — we cannot wholesale switch customers to very long terms. For registered nonprofits we can approve a provisional extension to Net60 (not Net90) pending formal docs (award letter or MOU). AE needs to upload docs and finance must sign off. @javier_ae can you confirm paperwork?

javier_ae: Confirmed — customer sent a grant award PDF and timeline showing funds available in ~55 days. I'll upload the docs and ask them to sign the MOU template. I also requested that we mark the invoice `ON_HOLD` while this is sorted so PSP doesn't retry card and cause repeated declines.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-349 status changed to ON_HOLD by tina_support

alexa_eng: Quick ETA: hotfix merged to staging, rolling to prod in ~30m. The patch removes the aggressive VAT normalization step. After deploy, support should retry the validation call (same curl) or use the billing console to re-run tax validation. Expected fix time: 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC.

tina_support: Thanks — I've added a note to the invoice: "TaxID validation error — engineering patch in progress; finance provisional Net60 requested." Customer notified to wait ~45m before retrying. I'll also apply the `raw_tax_id` metadata as a temporary workaround so they can try payment if they insist.

lee_finance: Provisional Net60 APPROVED pending signed MOU. Please update contract / billing terms to `Net60-provisional` and attach the award letter. finance will countersign once AE uploads the signed doc.

javier_ae: Uploaded award letter and MOU draft to the invoice thread in the console, requested customer's e-sign.

tina_support: Follow-up plan: 1) verify prod fix after deploy, re-run validation; 2) if still failing, apply manual payment acceptance and have finance capture via AR flow; 3) finalize Net60 provisional once MOU signed. tagging @alexa_eng for post-deploy verification.

billing-bot: Note added to INV-2026-349: "Provisional Net60 approved by finance pending MOU. Engineering patch deployed to staging."

tina_support: Closing loop here — will post final status when payment completes. :white_check_mark:
